paper: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
headline_strategy: Multi-agent LLM workflow with market, social, news, and fundamentals analysts; bull/bear research debate; trader synthesis; risk-seeking/neutral/conservative debate; and a final fund-manager BUY/SELL/HOLD decision with reflection memory
paper_portability_to_common_task: not defensibly executable as a monthly top-1,000 U.S. strategy from the nearest release because the decision graph has no paper-time inputs, sizing, portfolio, execution, or backtest path
missing_headline_objects: paper-era executable source and exact experiment configuration
frozen point-in-time prices, news, social, insider, statement, and indicator inputs
immutable model snapshots, complete prompts/tool schemas, sampling settings, trials and seeds
the published AAPL trace inputs/responses and all daily decision trajectories
position sizing, cash/holdings state, order/fill execution, shorting and cost semantics
the paper backtest runner, baseline implementations, metric code and return/NAV arrays
a paper-defined cross-sectional capital allocation rule across the monthly JKP universe
nearest_release_conflicts: The first code release arrived 52.4 hours after v7; every paper-version cutoff had only project-site files.
Analysts execute sequentially although the paper says concurrently.
Analysts, researchers, and trader use the quick model rather than the paper's deep-model assignment.
The fund manager is conflated with the risk judge, and the final output is categorical without execution state.
Only 6 of 11 appendix tool names exist, 13 rather than 60 indicator keys are selectable, and configured debate/risk/recursion limits are not wired.

rejected_substitutes.route: Run the v0.1.0 graph on current data for isolated dates
rejected_substitutes.reason: It is a post-paper architecture subset with changed models/tools and no paper backtest, sizing, execution, or point-in-time snapshot.

rejected_substitutes.route: Replay the author-rendered table, vectors, or AAPL case BUY
rejected_substitutes.reason: Rendered outputs contain no formation-time action array, holdings, fills, or return path; 16 of 17 vector endpoints conflict with Table 1.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use technical baselines or current Yahoo Buy-and-Hold
rejected_substitutes.reason: The baselines are not implemented in the release and all 12 literal-window current-Yahoo cells mismatch the paper.

rejected_substitutes.route: Map one categorical action per stock to equal weights
rejected_substitutes.reason: A literal common-task port would require 305,000 multi-agent decisions and invent sizing, cross-sectional allocation, persistence and execution.

rejected_substitutes.route: Replace multimodal inputs with JKP characteristics and a local model
rejected_substitutes.reason: This removes four analyst data modalities, tool use, paper model behavior, historical memory and the published decision trajectory.

result_policy: No post-paper one-day run, author-rendered output, baseline, categorical-action adapter, or reduced JKP agent is entered as a TradingAgents return. The positive paper results remain unresolved rather than classified as false or as JKP underperformance.
